name: Fukumen
source:
A strange Skywalker. Seems to be the same age as [url=/c22771]Masaya[/url]. They always wear an odd, henohenomoheji-like mask.

[spoiler]Later in the game, it is revealed that Fukumen is actually [url=https://vndb.org/c22805]Minamo[/url] in disguise. [/spoiler]
translation:
A strange Skywalker. Seems to be the same age as [url=/c22771]Masaya[/url]. They always wear an odd, henohenomoheji-like mask.
